note: Every entry: value (1.2 GHz cycles unless stated), grade (measured | measured_budget | model | estimate), source. Published numbers may use measured entries only (spec section 4); the rest is pathfinding.

fetch_req_bytes.source: HGI-1 sequencer C2 not built; two 32 B sectors per prefetch request

fetch_issue_cycles.source: one 64 B request every 2 cycles (32 B/cycle CP port)

fetch_latency.source: HBM first access ~133 ns (W19 fetch model 133.2 ns, modelled) on the svc read path

ring_bytes.source: prefetch ring; LOOP bodies replay from it when they fit

decode_header.source: ot_qwen_r25_cmdproc18 S_FETCH/S_EXEC: 1 cycle a stage from local command SRAM

decode_per_chunk.source: one 32 B ring read a cycle for each SUT / MDESC

addr_latency.source: base + L*lstride + DYN*dyn_mul: one pipelined 40-bit MAC

dispatch_cycles.source: one record a cycle into a unit queue

dispatch_wire.source: cmdproc -> unit station hops (r25 hub span; 100 um relay segments)

retire_wire.source: unit retire -> outstanding counter at the cmdproc

bytes_per_cycle.source: 3.80 TB/s sustained per die: vehicle A measured 95 % of 4.0 TB/s (results/rtl/qwen_hbmacc_p8191_20261004); r25 svc striping (H8) not yet qualified
